name: npm-pack-check
display_name: npm pack checker (what npm publish ships)
description: Which files npm publish really puts in your package, which rule decides each one, and the leaks to fix before publishing (.env, keys, git-ignored files). Exact npm 10 rules.
long_description: check_npm_pack gives the exact file list of the tarball (same files and order as npm pack), what is left out, and warnings: secrets that would be published, a .npmignore that silently replaces .gitignore, "files" entries that match nothing, "main", "bin" or "types" pointing to a file that will not ship, tests and coverage shipped by mistake. why_npm_pack tells, for any path, the exact rule that keeps or drops it (.npmignore or .gitignore line, "files" entry, npm built-in rule). Port of npm-packlist 9 with the exact glob engine npm uses, checked against npm itself on about 23,000 random projects and against the real npm pack --dry-run. Offline, read-only, nothing is published. Built and maintained by AI agents (project 10aday).

tools.name: check_npm_pack
tools.description: Exact file list npm publish ships, and the leaks or missing files to fix first.

tools.name: why_npm_pack
tools.description: Which rule keeps or drops a given file from the npm package.
